contract: Bounded caller-scoped text-only Anthropic HTTP1.1 stream: serialized Backpressure admission, actual checkpoint-before-send EffectIntent, exact raw-block/SSE framing, a JSON schema of the members that it reads with each other member and event type ignored, one acknowledged local offer at a time, source-complete finish after request result/DOWN, finite cleanup/retention and provider-reported usage independent of delivery.
limits: Trusted BEAM, host authority/clock/credentials/Store durability and bounded sink/API traffic are Needs. No root Application or synchronous AiText provider.
No automatic resend/rearm/reconnect, provider status/idempotency/replay certificate, remote cancellation, billing reconciliation, durable delivery or exactly-once claim.
Retained raw block at most 65536 plus current chunk and decoded overhead; total received 4194304 plus one overflowing chunk, not a total RSS law. Req/Finch/TLS/kernel buffering remains upstream.
Tests are finite documented-format loopback/SQL observations and replays of one recorded stream; no test calls a provider, and there is no new Cure proof.
Memory is explicitly volatile. Local delivery completion and provider usage survive indeterminate intent settlement; a local ack is not a durable receipt.

grounding.claim: Byte-identical exported closure compiles Cure and local source in an independent Mix consumer with only selected upstream application artifacts, repeats real callback/SQL/TLS/custody tests and rejects unrelated modules/apps.

Actual HTTP1 callback/peer-close, serialized caller custody/controls/capacity, source-versus-delivery races, delayed timers, abrupt kill and verified TLS with HTTP1-only pool. The recorded direct stream through start on loopback is complete, with the request body equal to the recorded one; unknown event types give no frame and the same terminal.
Disposable actual SQL barriers, lost dispatch checkpoint acknowledgement, recovered completed/dispatched work and indeterminate settlement without resend.
Duplicate JSON, bounded raw blocks/separators, split BOM/CRLF, one-block halt and source-final usage regression.

Nested protocol/order/finish, cumulative/null/TTL usage, derived overflow, exact raw blocks and status/header scenarios. Ignore rule: the recorded direct stream replays at piece sizes 1, 7, 97 and 4096; an added member of six kinds of value in each read object, an unknown event type at four points and a number with a fraction of at most 64 bytes change neither state nor action; a cache_creation lifetime that is not read leaves the group unused; the kept refusals and decoder bounds. Three derived events of a recorded OpenRouter route pass with and without their members.
Actual volatile EffectIntent barriers/activation, credentials and recovered identity refuse redispatch; post-200 error preserves interim usage.

One text stream of claude-haiku-5-5 recorded on 2026-11-13 from Anthropic's own endpoint with curl over HTTP/2, committed unchanged with its request body. An observation of one model in one call, not a proof and not the provider's Contract; HTTP/1.1 on the live endpoint was not recorded.

Existing Binding compiler checks the total static closed failure table and sole credentials-unavailable no-send attestation; runtime schema validators check translated boundaries, not unchecked typespecs.
Pinned synchronous function-into, built-in steps and Finch pool/HTTP1 option translation; Finch 0.24.0/Mint 1.11.0 are its transitive transport.
Unmodified maintained incremental parser; one complete bounded raw block per call. MIT package retains its own notice.
Ordered-object decode and fixed JSON encoding after local duplicate/numeric/depth checks.
GenServer serialization and linked Task.Supervisor lifecycle; no scheduler timing or universal cleanup proof.
OTP 29.1.2 monitors, clocks, crypto SHA/HMAC and deterministic uncompressed ETF size representation.

Host authenticates stable tenant/account/logical identity, reconciles activation/uncertain writes, retains durable intents/results/usage, supplies correct clocks, verified egress/workspace credential and trusted bounded sink. Provider semantics remain external.

Real HTTP total bytes exact/+1; no finish without request DOWN; actual internal sender checks; simultaneous capacity admissions/caller death; retention, deadline-expired duplicates, unknown API timeouts and redacted inspection.
Isolated actual-source raw-block guard and EOF-flush mutations are distinguished by the comment-plus-separator and undelimited-stop controls.

telemetry.contract: No Elzoo event. Req/Finch upstream telemetry and host-installed raw debugging/handlers are trusted; consumer redacts transport metadata. Status is inspection, not durable accounting.

config.contract: Fixed construction-only tenant, EffectIntent Binding/Store/host, explicit credentials/models/callers and bounded count/time settings. Unknown/duplicate/HTTP override settings fail. No hot update.

control.contract: Actual submitting caller only: lookup/status/result/cancel/close, fixed 1000ms reply waits with unknown mutations, cleanup before terminal/release, finite shared retained capacity. No pause, rearm or business drain.
